parrafo_1.es: Jorge Ramirez es el artista detrás de Polynesian Tattoo, en Miramar. Su especialidad es el tatuaje Polinesio y Melanesio a medida, piezas grandes y con significado, trabajadas en un estudio compartido dentro de un edificio de artistas en la SW 101st Ave.
parrafo_1.en: Jorge Ramirez is the artist behind Polynesian Tattoo, in Miramar. His specialty is custom Polynesian and Melanesian tattoo work, large and meaningful pieces, built inside a shared artist studio suite on SW 101st Ave.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientas y clientes lo describen como profesional, limpio y atento a cada detalle: 4.9 de calificación en 38 reseñas de Booksy, y más de 33 mil personas siguiendo su trabajo en Instagram.
parrafo_2.en: His clients describe him as professional, clean and attentive to every detail: a 4.9 rating across 38 Booksy reviews, and more than 33,000 people following his work on Instagram.

items.quote: It was my first time getting a tattoo. As you know how scary it can be getting your first because you have to make sure you are in the right hands of professionals. My tattoo artist was Jorge Ramirez. He did such an amazing job on my Polynesian/Melanesian arm band. The best part he was very kind and in answering all my questions and guiding me through the steps. I highly recommend Jorge for your first-time. You will be in trusted hands.
Jorge was awesome and very professional! Super clean shop

Great experience getting our tattoos. Jorge took care of me and 3 of my buddies, very comfortable and friendly environment. Highly recommend if you want something you won't regret. Very talented artists!
